title: The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining
abstract: arXiv:2609.32964v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. translated_title: 承诺-弃权回路：为什么语言模型产生幻觉而非弃权
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）常常通过给出自信的答案来产生幻觉，而不是选择弃权，即使它们没有足够的信息来可靠地回答问题。大量现有工作通过检测或弃权机制来缓解幻觉问题，但尚未解答模型内部最初是如何做出承诺或弃权这一决策的。我们通过机制分析来研究这一决策，将幻觉框架化为“无支持的承诺”：模型在表现出无法回答信号的情况下仍然做出承诺。利用因果门控方法，我们识别出了一个承诺-弃权回路（CAC），这是一个稀疏的、因果上可定位的注意力头和MLP子层子集，是这一决策的基础。在来自五个系列的十个语言模型（3B-14B）和三个基准测试上，CAC表现出一种反复出现的“积累但纠正不足”模式：促进承诺的组件在较早的层中不断积累承诺，而促进弃权的组件则在较晚的阶段才发挥作用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过机制分析识别出语言模型内部的“承诺-弃权回路”（CAC），揭示了幻觉产生的内在机制：促进承诺的组件在早期层中不断积累自信信号，而促进弃权的组件作用较晚且纠正不足，导致模型在信息不足时仍倾向于给出自信答案。
en_tdlr: Through mechanistic analysis, this paper identifies a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC) in language models, revealing that hallucination stems from an "accumulate-yet-undercorrect" pattern where commitment-promoting components build up confidence in earlier layers while abstention signals act too late to prevent unsupported answers.
